package snsqsdemo

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sns"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sqs"
)

func PublishToSNS(ctx context.Context, c *sns.Client) (*sns.PublishOutput, error) {
	return c.Publish(ctx, &sns.PublishInput{
		TopicArn: aws.String("arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:000:order-events"),
		Message:  aws.String("hello"),
	})
}

func SendToSQS(ctx context.Context, c *sqs.Client) (*sqs.SendMessageOutput, error) {
	return c.SendMessage(ctx, &sqs.SendMessageInput{
		QueueUrl:    aws.String("https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/000/orders-queue"),
		MessageBody: aws.String("hi"),
	})
}

func ReceiveFromSQS(ctx context.Context, c *sqs.Client) (*sqs.ReceiveMessageOutput, error) {
	return c.ReceiveMessage(ctx, &sqs.ReceiveMessageInput{
		QueueUrl: aws.String("https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/000/audit-queue"),
	})
}
